title: kyllinga cylindrica f. latifolia

It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The bioactive constituents of Kyllinga grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
